release_notes:
Fleet Duel adds an original two-player naval strategy game to FamilyWire: private 10 x 10 fleet setup, click or drag placement, rotate and randomize, deliberate select-and-Fire turns, clear hit/miss/sunk results, saved state, safe reconnect, resignation and agreed rematches.

Hidden fleets stay private to their owner until a ship sinks or a victory reveals both fleets to the two participants. Closing the panel keeps the game. Chat remains the default; invite identities, private learning and existing 48-hour retention remain.

Validation: all 95 tests passed on Windows and macOS CI. Windows installer and Intel/Apple Silicon Mac packages passed native startup checks. The matching persistent relay is deployed and healthy. Tested source tree: e95294674bc23c5280d2e3cb2a7fab07b48ed29e; merged source: a9f976b23f0556849ef0963151748a1e83869b08.

Update both players before inviting Fleet Duel. Windows: Updates > Check for updates > Download update > Restart & install. Mac: download the ZIP for Intel (x64) or Apple Silicon (arm64). These Mac archives are unsigned; automatic Mac updates still require signing.
